title: SensorDash · Drives & Retention
description: Read-only Windows SSD/NVMe observations from SensorDash, Pi root SSD SMART and transport metrics from an optional host collector, plus VictoriaMetrics retention history.

options.content:
### WINDOWS STORAGE · SSD/NVMe
Live temperatures, utilization and drive signals from SensorDash. Missing hardware sensors are left missing; fixed warning/critical temperature specifications are excluded from live heat graphs.

panels.title: Detected storage devices
panels.description: Count of storage devices with exported sensor metadata.

panels.title: Highest drive temperature
panels.description: Highest currently reported physical drive temperature, with the originating drive and sensor displayed below the value. Excludes fixed warning/critical temperature specifications. No current sensor readings means no value.

panels.title: Local history buffer
panels.description: SQLite database plus WAL/SHM file sizes on Windows; retained as a bounded retry buffer.

panels.title: Storage catalog sensors
panels.description: Storage sensor descriptions in the active catalog, not a count of live readings.

options.content:
### WINDOWS STORAGE HISTORY
Recorded physical drive readings. This is not VictoriaMetrics' own Pi disk usage.

panels.title: Drive temperatures
panels.description: All available real storage temperatures. Do not infer an absent NVMe composite sensor.

panels.title: Drive utilization
panels.description: Load/active-time channels depend on what LibreHardwareMonitor reports for each drive.

panels.title: Drive throughput
panels.description: Read/write bytes per second if the drive exposes matching throughput sensors.

panels.title: Drive data counters
panels.description: Raw storage Data readings. LibreHardwareMonitor may report GiB or another scale; this panel intentionally does not mislabel them as bytes.

options.content:
### WINDOWS TELEMETRY RETRY BUFFER & SENSOR CATALOG
SQLite on Windows is a bounded outbound retry spool. Long-term samples live in VictoriaMetrics on the Pi; expand the archive section below only when needed.

panels.title: Windows local buffer · disk footprint
panels.description: Only aggregate file sizes, not database contents, filenames, or per-sensor allocation.

panels.title: Storage sensor inventory
panels.description: Read-only storage sensor catalog with canonical stable sensor IDs. Names may be sanitized for display.

options.content:
### RASPBERRY PI · ROOT SSD HEALTH
Host-side SMART collection runs every five minutes via node-exporter; Windows SSD/NVMe readings above remain exclusively SensorDash data. Missing or stale SMART readings mean **unknown**, not healthy. The SandForce SSD's normalized life field is intentionally not shown as a remaining-life percentage. Lifetime fault counts are historical baselines; changes over time matter more than nonzero starting values. SSD write totals have approximately 1 GiB resolution.

panels.title: SMART collection
panels.description: 1 = collector read SMART successfully; 0 = failed; empty = no recent data. Status does not imply drive health.

panels.title: SSD SMART health
panels.description: Drive-reported overall SMART assessment; absent if no successful collection.

panels.title: SSD temperature
panels.description: Actual SATA SMART attribute 194 when available, not a drive specification.

panels.title: SSD writes · past 24h
panels.description: Difference between highest and lowest reported lifetime writes over 24 hours. This is an observed change, not an extrapolated daily rate; the firmware reports whole GiB, so smaller writes may show as zero. Requires recent successful SMART collection.

panels.title: Pi filesystem free
panels.description: Available space on the Pi's / filesystem, distinct from VictoriaMetrics internals.

panels.title: Collector sample age
panels.description: Time since the last host collection attempt, based on a precision-preserved Unix timestamp. Expected collection interval is five minutes. Yellow after six minutes, red after ten; no data means exporter/ingestion unavailable.

panels.title: SSD lifetime reads / writes
panels.description: Cumulative lifetime firmware reads and writes; not reads or writes generated within the selected time range. Firmware resolution is approximately 1 GiB.

panels.title: SSD SMART fault counters · lifetime
panels.description: Firmware lifetime totals, not errors occurring in the displayed window. Watch for increments above the initial baselines (3 retired blocks, 1 program failure, 0 erase failures, 0 uncorrectable errors).

panels.title: SSD temperature · history
panels.description: Decoded temperature.current from smartctl. Values prior to the SandForce parsing fix may be incorrect; select a range starting after the fix or wait for those historical samples to age out.

panels.title: USB and kernel failures · since boot
panels.description: Counts are scanned from kernel logs for the current boot, not global lifetime totals, and may include USB peripherals other than the root SSD. Counts reset on reboot.

panels.title: Pi telemetry archive · VictoriaMetrics storage and retention evidence
panels.description: Expand for the server-side history database, free space, ingestion and sample counts. These are not sizes attributed to individual Windows sensors; no deletion or retention adjustment is performed here.

panels.title: VictoriaMetrics stored data
panels.description: Actual on-disk storage reported by VictoriaMetrics, including storage subsystems. Not the size of the Windows SQLite database.

panels.title: Pi volume free
panels.description: Free bytes on the filesystem containing the VictoriaMetrics data directory. Leave adequate space for compactions.

panels.title: Sensor series active
panels.description: Number of recently active Windows sensor series for this host, not total historical series ever stored.

panels.title: Samples · selected range
panels.description: Observed Windows sensor samples in the selected Grafana range, not an estimate of SQLite page usage.

panels.title: VictoriaMetrics storage allocation
panels.description: VictoriaMetrics internal storage sizes by type; sum may include index/cache categories.

panels.title: History ingest rate
panels.description: Five-minute overall VictoriaMetrics ingest-rate estimate, including DNS/VPN and SensorDash data.

panels.title: Top 25 sensor sample counts · selected range
panels.description: Readings stored in VictoriaMetrics for this computer and time range. Sample counts are not per-sensor disk bytes; VictoriaMetrics compresses and shares storage structures.

targets.expr: topk(25, (count_over_time(sensordash_reading_value{host=~"$host"}[$__range]) unless on(host,sensor) (sensordash_sensor_info_value{host=~"$host",device_type="Storage",kind="Temperature",name=~"(?i).*(warning|critical).*"} == 1))) * on(host,sensor) group_left(name,device) (label_replace(sensordash_sensor_info_value{host=~"$host",alias!="unassigned"} == 1, "name", "$1", "alias", "(.+)") or (sensordash_sensor_info_value{host=~"$host",alias="unassigned"} == 1))
